title: Riedel Glas Glashütte Kufstein
highlights: Traditionsreiche Schauglashütte der weltberühmten Glasdynastie Riedel
Sinnfonie des Glases: Multimediale Erlebnisreise für alle menschlichen Sinne
Faszinierender Einblick in das traditionelle Mundblasen edler Gläser und Dekanter
kurzbeschreibung: The Riedel Glashütte in Kufstein offers a multimedia experience and artisanal glassmaking craftsmanship with the Sinnfonie.
beschreibung:
World-Class Traditional Glassmaking

At the time-honoured Glashütte Riedel in Kufstein, centuries-old glass craftsmanship merges with modern sensory impressions. Wine connoisseurs and sommeliers worldwide appreciate the functional crystal glasses from this Tyrolean manufactory. During a tour, visitors experience up close how masterful one-of-a-kind pieces are created from red-hot glass.

Sinnfonie of the Senses and Glassmaking Workshop

The multimedia experience Sinnfonie takes guests on a sensory journey of sound, scent, and form. From a gallery, visitors can watch skilled glassblowers performing their precise and demanding craft.
